name: Ihou Fuu
source:
In the year 2215, inhabitants of Miikemura on planet H3111 encounter an alien being.
Its origin and purpose are unknown. It possesses powers far beyond humanity.
Could it be an android from a nearby civilization? An unknown species?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084189.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
2215年，H3111行星上的三池村居民遇见了一名外星生命。
无人知道它来自何方，又有什么目的。它拥有远超人类的力量。
它究竟是附近某个文明制造的仿生人，还是一个从未被发现的物种？
